name: 西游记451
english_description: Journey to the West, from the same ES II mudlib family as this collection's xyj42/xyj2000, sharing their Thirty-Three Heavens / Peach Garden / Penglai map style and Lingtai Fangcun Mountain sect. Registration here has no explicit "new character" keyword -- entering an English ID that isn't already on file goes straight to "Creating a new character named X, are you sure? (y/n)" -- and talent points aren't assigned by adjusting slots but through a reroll loop ("Do you accept these talent values? [n|y|q]"). New characters land at the South City Inn; apprenticing to the sect's senior master correctly fails for outsiders (a real in-code experience-and-Taoism-points gate) but succeeds under a junior disciple, and death sends characters through the underworld (阴阳界), where Judge Cui reviews the register of life and death and revives them with a real stat penalty.
